limits: Structural checks do not certify self-intersection absence, anatomical correctness or final rig/deformation quality.
Separate membrane/fin/eye meshes remain separate; only the main body/head/neck and limb/digit cage is tested as one connected surface.
Four poses are in-memory diagnostic transformations of the study rig, not replacement runtime Actions.
Symmetry is vertex proximity across X=0, not a proof of perfect mirrored polygon connectivity.

body_connectivity.method: Actual mesh-edge graph, metadata-located and independently coordinate-matched 64 vertex neck ring, two incident faces per ring edge; no overlap claimed as weld.

symmetry.method: Nearest reflected vertex across world X=0, all anatomy meshes together.
